PowerOneLineOne: For the rest of the scene, all attacks against a character of
PowerOneLineTwo: your choosing get a circumstance dice. You also get to know
PowerOneLineThree: health and their elemental weaknesses and resistances.
PowerTwoLineOne: Create a silent holographic display. This can be used to relay
PowerTwoLineTwo: information to allies. It can also be used to help with persuade
PowerTwoLineThree: rolls or to buff allies on their Wits and Education Rolls if you
PowerThreeLineOne: Figure out the location of origin of any broadcast or recording
PowerThreeLineTwo: to which you're exposed. You can also detect any phenomena
PowerThreeLineThree: involved in its creation, and sense any tampering or alteration.
PowerThreeLineFour: The creator and time of creation also become known to you.
PowerFourLineOne: Know your way through an unfamiliar location, as if you had
PowerFourLineTwo: access to a mini-map. Complete with limited awareness of how
PowerFourLineThree: many humans, animals, and Digimon are around you and
PowerFourLineFour: where in the environment they are.
